groups.label: Matched Addis filter
fields: Fabs ratio to the matched Addis filter

Adama.note: CSU AMOD pilot, July 2024: PTFE filters for FTIR, each with a date-paired quartz filter for TOR. The spectrum-to-filter map is the pilot's provisional, date-based one.

Bishoftu.note: SPARTAN Bishoftu filters scored by the frozen external pilot.

notes: Pairing: date candidate; sampler equivalence and spectrum ID map unconfirmed.
TOR is measured on the date-paired quartz filter; its fractions are divided by the quartz volume.
